t: A machine used to spawn mobs. When provided with power, $(l:agr_hus/essence)Essence$() and any entity in a  $(l:tools/mib)Mob Imprisonment Tool$() it will spawn them around it. $(br2)It will count the entities nearby and stop if there are too many.
一台用于生成生物的机器。当提供能量、$(l:agr_hus/essence)精华液$() 以及装有任意实体的 $(l:tools/mib)生物捕捉工具$() 时，它会在周围生成这些生物。$(br2)它会统计附近的实体数量，过多时将停止工作。
